def axis(k, v, h, km, vm, form):
    n = len(k)
    j = np.arange(n - 1)
    A = np.zeros((n, n))
    d = {'ar': (k[:-1] + k[1:]) * 0.5, 'ha': 2 * k[:-1] * k[1:] / (k[:-1] + k[1:]), 'geo': np.sqrt(k[:-1] * k[1:])}[km] / h ** 2
    a = {'face': (v[:-1] + v[1:]) * 0.5, 'left': v[:-1], 'right': v[1:]}[vm] / h
    A[j, j] += d
    A[j + 1, j + 1] += d
    A[j, j + 1] -= d
    A[j + 1, j] -= d
    if form == 'flux':
        A[j, j] += np.maximum(a, 0)
        A[j + 1, j] -= np.maximum(a, 0)
        A[j, j + 1] += np.minimum(a, 0)
        A[j + 1, j + 1] -= np.minimum(a, 0)
    elif form == 'velocity':
        p = np.maximum(v[1:] / h, 0)
        q = np.maximum(-v[:-1] / h, 0)
        A[j, j] += q
        A[j, j + 1] -= q
        A[j + 1, j + 1] += p
        A[j + 1, j] -= p
    elif form == 'facevelocity':
        p = np.maximum(a, 0)
        q = np.maximum(-a, 0)
        A[j, j] += q
        A[j, j + 1] -= q
        A[j + 1, j + 1] += p
        A[j + 1, j] -= p
    elif form == 'none':
        pass
    return A

def verify(S, y, r, u, b, c):
    global maxima
    w = c['weights']
    l = c['lam_lower']
    h = c['lam_upper']
    nu = c['nu_sum']
    g = S.T @ (S @ w - y) + r * w
    p = 0.5 * (np.linalg.norm(S @ w - y) ** 2 + r * (w @ w))
    assert np.all(l >= 0) and np.all(h >= 0) and (abs(p - c['primal_objective']) < 1e-09)
    gap = p - c['dual_lower_bound']
    assert gap >= -1e-09
    err = np.array([max(abs(w.sum() - b), float(np.max(-w)), float(np.max(w - u))), np.max(abs(g + nu - l + h)), max(np.max(abs(l * w)), np.max(abs(h * (w - u)))), abs(gap)])
    maxima = np.maximum(maxima, err)
    assert np.max(err) < 1e-08, err
